## Business Overview
JobSphere is not just a job listing platform; it embodies the aspiration for a fulfilling career that resonates with personal values and ambitions. It offers a sense of security and empowerment, helping individuals find their “dream mission” in a competitive landscape. The ideal customer is a driven professional, likely in their late 20s to 40s, who prioritizes transparency and trust in their job search.
